context_requirements: Active c-Src or STAT3 signaling for growth inhibition
Intact integrated stress response / eIF2alpha-ATF4 pathway for UPR-like transcriptional output
Mitochondrial activity and oxidative phosphorylation for pyrvinium-like metabolic effects
Tumor cells with deregulated proliferation and survival pathways; normal/non-transformed cells respond weakly
falsifiers: No induction of ATF4, DDIT3, TRIB3, CHAC1, XBP1, HSPA5 or other ISR/UPR genes at 6 h or 24 h in any responsive line
No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes (e.g., CCND1, CDK4, CDK6, E2F2, MKI67) at 24 h
No difference in response between A375/A549 and HA1E, or no response in any of the nine lines
Predominant interferon signature without ISR/UPR or cell-cycle changes

evidence.supports: Oxfendazole inhibits c-Src, induces G0/G1 arrest, downregulates CDK4/CDK6/RB/E2F1 and upregulates p53/p21 in NSCLC.
Albendazole inhibits EMT in A375 melanoma via AKT/GSK-3beta and Snail, with E-cadherin up and N-cadherin down.
Pyrvinium pamoate triggers integrated stress response/UPR-like transcriptome changes and metabolic/redox reprogramming in myeloid leukemia cells.
Flubendazole induces apoptosis, G2/M accumulation, STAT3 inhibition and reduces MMP-2/MMP-9 in triple-negative breast cancer.

changes: Removed HSPB1 from proximal_up: generic stress/proteostasis gene, not a specific proximal transcriptional output of anthelmintic ISR/UPR or c-Src/STAT3 inhibition.
Removed evidence PMID 42353136: abstract concerns antiviral niclosamide-polysaccharide nasal spray and does not support the stated anthelmintic anticancer transcriptional mechanism.
